edge_explainer: CAUSE: Q1 FYE-27 printed 2026-07-29 — revenue $1,289M +22%, royalty $715M +22% with data-centre royalties 'more than doubling', licence $574M +23%, non-GAAP EPS $0.45 beat $0.40, Q2 guide $1.38B/+21.6%. Stock -8.1%, -8.1%, +7.4% over three sessions; press attributes it to smartphone softness, which the shareholder letter never mentions. PATH: the 3-year high of $439.46 was set 2026-06-18 — 46 days old at the screen date — after a +320% run from the Feb-2026 low of $100.02. ARM is +141.4% off that low. This is a blow-off retrace, not a multi-year quality de-rate; the winners' -46% signature (HUBS -77%, CTSH -53%, SAP -48%) was earned over years. EXHAUSTED fired and was RIGHT; the screen's 0.35-weight 'depth' term actively fights it and must be gated on the AGE of the high. TWO HONESTY FINDINGS, both disclosed (review flag, not ELEVATE): (1) ACV — management's OWN normalizer for licence lumpiness — grew 13% against reported licence growth of 23%, so ~10pp of the marketed licensing strength is timing; (2) GAAP operating margin FELL to 7.1% from 10.8%, i.e. GAAP operating profit declined ~20% on +22% revenue, while the letter leads with non-GAAP margin EXPANDING to 41.2%. GAAP-vs-non-GAAP opex wedge $429M/quarter; SBC $343M = 27% of revenue, the highest in the cohort. No full-year FY27 guidance is given at all. THE STRUCTURAL FINDING: the screen admitted ARM on 98% gross margin, but the growth leg ARM is now selling is the Arm AGI CPU — PRODUCTION SILICON, demand book raised from $1B to >$2B across FY27-28, with manufacturing capacity already 'secured'. Silicon carries 30-55% gross margins. The growth driver mechanically destroys the quality metric that selected the name, and converts a zero-capital royalty model into one carrying take-or-pay-shaped capacity commitments — entered into precisely the cycle the house prices at 45% break odds. ENCODE: a gross-margin quality gate is invalid when the disclosed growth driver is a move down the stack; read the MARGINAL mix, not the trailing blend. CONFLICT: royalties are recognised when the licensee SHIPS, so data-centre royalty tracks server units 1-2 quarters behind the order book — a credit break stops exactly those units. The -46.7% prices the June melt-up and none of the break: 50.5x TTM sales is ~90th percentile of ARM's own 3y range, 120x forward non-GAAP EPS, 210x GAAP.
